stories.title: Typed persistent channel settings
stories.text: As an operator, I can save partial channel settings and combine them predictably.

stories.title: Resolve the effective launch policy
stories.text: As an operator, I can override saved policy at launch without repeating every flag.

stories.title: Prove settings at the real CLI boundary

stories.text: As an operator, I can see what is installed and what remains under verification.
